fixes.explanation: That's right, baker. The man says, "These are the sons of Zadok, the only Levites who may approach the LORD to minister before Him." (Ezekiel 40:46). Look at who's getting set apart here: not all the Levites, just Zadok's sons. He says it right after pointing out two chambers in the inner court, one for the priests who keep charge of the temple and one for the priests who keep charge of the altar.

problems.problem: The ending still restates that only Zadok's sons may approach, without adding insight.
